title: Nahau (Theme 7: Elimu ya mazingira)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child gives the meaning of the whole nahau on cleanliness and the environment and uses it where that meaning fits.

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes a sentence with "kupiga deki" and one with "kutia maji" (to water).

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: ""Kukata tamaa" maana yake ni nini?" Kwa nini "kukata kamba ya tamaa" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Nahau ina maana tofauti na maneno yake. "Kukata tamaa" ni kuacha kuwa na matumaini.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: ""Kula chumvi" maana yake ni nini?" Kwa nini "kuwa na hamu ya kula" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kila nahau ina maana yake. "Kula chumvi" ni kuwa na uzoefu wa miaka mingi.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Usikate ___ ukishindwa mara moja." Kwa nini "kamba" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Nahau hazibadiliki: kukata tamaa, kupiga moyo konde. Neno moja likibadilika, maana hupotea.
Kupiga deki ni kusafisha sakafu kwa maji; inatumiwa kwa sakafu.

checks.question: Tumia "kupiga pasi" katika sentensi.
checks.answer: Alipiga pasi nguo zake za shule.
